en.longDescription:
EdgeDB is an open-source graph-relational database with a modern type system, backed by PostgreSQL.

Server on port 5656. Credentials use SERVICE_PASSWORD_EDGEDB with a dedicated Postgres backend.

de.shortDescription: Graph-relationale Datenbank auf Basis von PostgreSQL
